title: Two reviewed heads trial at once and both land with one trial each
description: Run the real loop cycle against a real temporary Postgres control plane and a scratch bare Git remote: two reviewed heads trial at the same time; when one merges, the other is re-merged onto the new tip and pushed without a candidate-changed refusal or a second trial. The batch gate then verifies the tip and the deploy watch serves it.

steps.name: Merge two concurrently trialled heads through the real loop
